title: NPR: Along U.S. Route 1, Maine voters worry about heating oil, gas and Canadian tariffs
summary: Home to both Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic candidate Troy Jackson, Maine's senate race has put rural Aroostook County in the spotlight.

title: NPR: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

title: NPR: COMIC: How the census gives your state power (and what Trump wants to change)
summary: The census is used to determine how much say your state has in Congress and the Electoral College. President Trump failed to alter it during his first term, but he's trying again ahead of 2030.

summary: Los republicanos lograron avances con los latinos en el último ciclo electoral, pero la economía y la frustración por la política migratoria de Donald Trump han corroído ese apoyo.

title: NPR: Trump visits deep red Oklahoma to campaign for GOP candidates ahead of midterms
summary: President Trump makes his first campaign stop this October in deep red Oklahoma.

title: NPR: Political analyst on Trump's campaign stop in reliably red Oklahoma
summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to political analyst and columnist Ron Brownstein about President Trump's pre-midterm campaign visit to the Republican-majority state of Oklahoma.
